title: Smooth Stars
notes: Fixed heavy lag while playing a Sollari. Looking a skill up meant going through every skill in the game, and the Sollari's Fuel did that thousands of times a frame. Skills are indexed now and their stats are cached for the frame: a Sollari's own work per frame went from about 4.8 ms to about 0.3 ms, and every other class got a bit faster too.
The Sollari's model draws in about 30 pieces instead of about 115 (its little lights are merged), and looks exactly the same.
